sprachhinweis.text: The legal texts of PflegeNavigator EU are maintained in German only. The German version is the authoritative one.

loeschen.hinweisTitel: Please send your request by email
loeschen.hinweisText: We do not currently offer an online form. Please send your request by email.
loeschen.schritt1: Write an email to the address below.
loeschen.schritt2: Include your case code so that we delete the right case.
loeschen.schritt3: If you are acting on behalf of someone else, please say so. We will then get in touch about the authorisation.
loeschen.danachText: We will confirm the deletion once it has been carried out. If any information has to be kept for legal reasons, such as payment records, we will tell you.
loeschen.frist: We will reply within one month.
loeschen.unumkehrbar: A deletion cannot be undone. Your case code will no longer work afterwards.
loeschen.sicherheitTitel: Your case code is your access
loeschen.sicherheitText: Anyone who knows the case code can open your information. Only send it to this address and do not share it with others.
